title: Weak and Unowned References knowledge check

questions.prompt: What is the most direct learning goal for this lesson?
options: Replace a focused example with unrelated code.
The main goal is to apply weak in a small Swift example and verify the result.
Use weak and unowned references only for visual styling.
Skip type checking and accept any result.
questions.answer_key: The main goal is to apply weak in a small Swift example and verify the result.
questions.explanation: Weak and Unowned References is best learned through a small, verifiable example. ARC manages class-instance lifetimes through references. Strong cycles can keep instances alive; use `weak` or `unowned` only when the ownership/lifetime model justifies it.
